threshold_calibration.limitation: penetration_tolerance_m = 0.03 is Replica-calibrated to absorb observed floor-plane fit bias. It is NOT a physical claim that 3 cm penetration is acceptable. Future importer/floor refit work should revisit this threshold.

floor_plane_fit_bias_observed.candidate_set: 19 entities whose footprint clips the floor polygon (in_plane_gap == 0) with centroid above the plane

pass_count_table.note: chosen — clean furniture cluster incl. basket + tables

threshold_calibration.candidate_selection_note: Candidate floor pairs were inspected by measurement, not intuition. Rug (obj_60) is excluded because it is flat and ambiguous under the fitted plane (lowest corner -0.057 m and centroid effectively at/below the fitted floor). Structural columns/door (obj_46, obj_36, obj_84) are excluded as poor 'on floor' exemplars despite passing. F1 = obj_39 (stool): least-negative non-structural bottom_gap (-0.0152 m), clear resting-on-floor semantics, not flat, not structural; passes at penetration_tolerance >= 0.02 so the fixture does not force the looser 0.05.

synthetic_room_convention.description: Right-handed frame, gravity = (0,0,-1), up = (0,0,1). Synthetic surfaces use exact geometry (no fit bias). Floor at z=0 (interior/up normal +z), north wall at y=2 (interior normal -y), ceiling at z=2 (interior normal -z). Plane equation a*x+b*y+c*z+d=0; (a,b,c) is the interior/up-facing normal. Synthetic entity centroids are given explicitly because ON_SURFACE consumes the centroid.

clause_glossary.bottom_gap: min over 8 AABB corners of signed_distance(corner, plane) (== sd_min)
clause_glossary.ON_SURFACE: support_capable AND centroid_on_support_side AND contact AND footprint_ok

cases.rationale: Real Replica floor-rest positive, grounded by measurement. Stool resting on floor_25: footprint inside the floor polygon (in_plane_gap == 0), centroid well above the fitted plane, bottom_gap -0.0152 m (within the [-0.03, 0.02] contact band). Least-negative non-structural candidate. Numeric clause values recorded for audit; the assertion is the boolean (exact AABB comes from the live enriched-v2 bundle, so the test recomputes from the bundle and asserts ON_SURFACE == true).

Synthetic floor positive with slight penetration. bottom_gap = -0.01 (inside the penetration band -0.03); footprint inside the floor polygon; centroid above. Pins the shallow-penetration positive on exact geometry (no fit bias).

Floating above the floor: bottom_gap = 0.04 > contact_threshold 0.02, so contact fails (clean single-clause hover rejection). This is the NEAR-but-not-ON case: polygon-mode NEAR distance = hypot(0.04, 0) = 0.04 <= 0.05 (NEAR yes), but ON_SURFACE no.

At resting height (bottom_gap 0, contact passes) but laterally outside the floor polygon: footprint at x in [3.0, 3.2] is 1.0 m beyond the polygon edge x=2, so in_plane_gap = 1.0 and footprint_ok fails (clean single-clause footprint rejection).

Entity entirely below the floor (wrong side). Centroid below the plane (centroid_on_support_side fails) AND bottom_gap -0.50 well past -penetration_tolerance (contact fails). Multi-clause by construction; labeled as such.

Entity flush against the north wall: in contact (bottom_gap 0), centroid on the interior side, footprint within the wall polygon — yet support_capable fails because dot(wall_normal (0,-1,0), up (0,0,1)) = 0 < cos(30). Clean single-clause role rejection: the up-facing gate excludes verticals even when contact/side/footprint pass.

Flush ceiling contact: contact passes (bottom_gap 0.01 within band), centroid on interior side, footprint within the ceiling polygon — yet support_capable fails because dot(ceiling_normal (0,0,-1), up) = -1 < cos(30). Clean single-clause role rejection that ISOLATES the up-facing gate from the contact gate (a flush ceiling light is in contact but is not 'on' the ceiling in the support sense).

Entity below the ceiling but not touching it (bottom_gap 0.30, far beyond both contact and near thresholds): support_capable fails (downward normal) AND contact fails. Explicitly multi-clause under Design B (role gate + contact gate); F3 already covers the pure single-clause gap rejection, so this is a ceiling gap-rejected sanity case rather than a clean gap test.

cases.threshold_pinning: Passes at penetration_tolerance_m = 0.05, rejected at 0.03. Mirrors the real sofa (obj_9, bottom_gap -0.043).
cases.rationale: Deep-penetration single-clause rejection on the penetration side. bottom_gap = -0.04 is below -penetration_tolerance (0.03), so contact fails even though support/side/footprint pass. Makes the D6 threshold choice (0.03 not 0.05) auditable as a fixture assertion: a looser 0.05 would wrongly accept this; 0.03 correctly rejects it.
